tool_schemas.name: scrape_recent_category_papers
tool_schemas.description: Scrapes arXiv’s “recent” listing for the given category and returns up to max_results normalized paper records, creating a scrape job and storing per-paper/category observations for reproducible snapshots. This endpoint returns a bounded list (not cursor-paged); if more than max_results papers are present, only the newest max_results are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when category is missing/empty or max_results is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to run scrapes, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate/quota limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR/NOT_FOUND when the category page cannot be retrieved (e.g., invalid category or arXiv is unavailable).

tool_schemas.name: search_papers
tool_schemas.description: Runs an arXiv keyword search and returns up to max_results matching papers as normalized metadata, recording the search as a job for later audit and analysis. Results are returned as a bounded list (not cursor-paged); if more than max_results matches exist, only the top max_results are returned according to arXiv’s search ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when keyword is missing/blank or max_results is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot execute searches, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate/quota limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the arXiv search endpoint fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: get_paper_info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches canonical metadata for a single paper by arXiv paper_id and returns the normalized paper record (and may refresh stored metadata if already known). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when paper_id is missing or not a valid arXiv identifier format, NOT_FOUND when no paper exists for that id, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access paper metadata, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate/quota limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when arXiv metadata retrieval fails.

tool_schemas.name: analyze_trends
tool_schemas.description: Computes trend analytics for the given category over the last days using stored per-paper/category observations (captured via prior scrapes/searches) and returns aggregated signals such as trending terms/topics and counts for the time window. This endpoint returns a single analysis result (not paged) for the requested window and will only reflect data actually captured in the underlying snapshots. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when days is not a positive integer or category is invalid/blank, NOT_FOUND when there is insufficient captured data for that category/window to compute trends, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot run analytics, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when analytics rate/quota limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_papers
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored papers with optional filtering and cursor pagination. Returns normalized paper records that have been captured or fetched by this service. Refuses invalid filter combinations and returns TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded.

arxiv_id.description: Filter by exact arXiv identifier (e.g., 2401.01234 or cs/9901001).

category.description: Filter to papers that have this category (primary or secondary).

published_from.description: Include papers published at or after this timestamp.

published_to.description: Include papers published at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get_crawl_run
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single crawl run job by id and returns its stored job record including status and error fields. Refuses access when the caller is not authorized to view the run.

include_items.description: When true, includes the crawl_run_items for this run (paged).

items_limit.description: Maximum crawl_run_items to return when include_items=true.

items_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for crawl_run_items when include_items=true.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_crawl_run
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a crawl run job. If the run is queued it transitions to cancelled; if running it requests cancellation and transitions to cancelled when acknowledged. Refuses cancellation for runs already in a terminal state (succeeded/failed/cancelled).

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search query job by id and returns its stored job record including status, result_count and error fields. Refuses access when the caller is not authorized to view the query.

include_results.description: When true, includes the search_query_results for this query (paged).

results_limit.description: Maximum search_query_results to return when include_results=true.

results_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for search_query_results when include_results=true.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a search query job. If the query is queued it transitions to cancelled; if running it requests cancellation and transitions to cancelled when acknowledged. Refuses cancellation for queries already in a terminal state (succeeded/failed/cancelled).

tool_schemas.name: update_paper_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates a paper’s lifecycle status. Allows transitioning an active paper to tombstoned to hide/disable it while preserving referential integrity for existing runs and observations. Refuses invalid transitions and refuses updates when the caller is not authorized.

paper_id.description: The papers.id (internal id) or arXiv identifier to update.

tombstone_reason.description: Optional reason stored for audit/debugging (may be omitted from public paper views).

metadata.name: arXiv Research Assistant
metadata.description: This backend supports an arXiv-focused research assistant that crawls recent-category listing pages, runs keyword searches, fetches canonical paper metadata by arXiv id, and computes trend analytics over recent time windows.
